verdict.rationale: The evidence covers agent checkout, payment handlers, cart attribution fields and order webhooks delivered to the agent. Nothing documents how agent-originated payments settle into merchant payouts or show up in merchant financial reporting and reconciliation. The Merchant of Record statement and UTM/referrer attribution are adjacent signals, not a documented payout or reconciliation flow.

support.subject: As a merchant, agent-originated payments settle through documented payout and reporting flows, reconcilable like any other channel
